name: ChatGPT
promptStyle: Clear task framing, role-based instruction, structured steps, explicit constraints, and defined output formatting.
principles: State the primary objective, role, and context near the very beginning of the prompt.
Break complex operations into ordered, numbered steps or modular requirements.
Explicitly declare negative constraints and boundaries (what NOT to do).
Specify target output format (tables, markdown headings, code blocks, or schema).
Request clarification only when missing information materially blocks execution.

rules.title: Front-load Context and Objective
rules.description: Place the primary task and objective at the top of the prompt to establish framing before detailed instructions.
rules.sourceTitle: OpenAI Prompt Engineering Guide - Strategy: Write clear instructions

rules.title: Specify Output Format Explicitly
rules.description: State exact structure requirements such as Markdown headings, bullet points, JSON schemas, or step-by-step prose.
rules.sourceTitle: OpenAI Prompt Engineering Guide - Specify the desired output length and format

rules.title: Use Ordered Delimited Steps
rules.description: Use numbered lists for sequential tasks and clear delimiters (triple quotes or markdown sections) to separate instructions from reference material.
rules.sourceTitle: OpenAI Prompt Engineering Guide - Specify the steps required to complete a task

contextStrategy: Place the most relevant reference text directly under a clearly labeled Reference Material section using markdown delimiters. Clearly distinguish user facts from instructions.
outputGuidance: Use structured markdown with numbered procedures, bulleted constraints, and code snippets or tables where applicable.

references.title: OpenAI Prompt Engineering Guide
references.whyRelevant: Official OpenAI best practices for structuring clear instructions, delimiting context, and specifying outputs.
